title: Adapter-Based Few-Shot Continual Learning for Malicious Packet Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.23536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The continual evolution of malware variants necessitates detection systems that can adapt to new threats without retraining from scratch. However, continually updating models on new data often leads to catastrophic forgetting, where previously learned knowledge is overwritten. While continual learning has been increasingly explored for malware detection, the specific setting of Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL), where new malware classes must be learned from only a small number of labeled examples, remains comparatively underexplored. Therefore, this work investigates the FSCIL setting for malware classification. To address the stability-plasticity dilemma, we propose a hybrid framework that leverages a Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) backbone initialized through domain-specific pre-training on malware packets. translated_title: 基于适配器的少样本持续学习用于恶意数据包识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23536v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：恶意软件变种的持续演变要求检测系统能够适应新威胁，而无需从头重新训练。然而，在新数据上持续更新模型通常会导致灾难性遗忘，即先前学习的知识被覆盖。尽管持续学习在恶意软件检测中已得到越来越多的探索，但少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）这一特定设置——即仅需少量标记示例即可学习新恶意软件类别——仍相对未被充分研究。因此，本工作研究了恶意软件分类中的FSCIL设置。为了解决稳定性-可塑性困境，我们提出了一种混合框架，该框架利用通过恶意软件数据包上的领域特定预训练初始化的自监督学习（SSL）骨干网络。我们的方法在基础会话期间采用低秩适应（LoRA）来高效调整模型，同时冻结……
tldr: 提出了一种结合自监督预训练和低秩适应的混合框架，首次系统性地解决了恶意数据包识别中的少样本类增量学习问题，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: A hybrid framework combining self-supervised pre-training and low-rank adaptation is proposed to systematically address few-shot class-incremental learning for malicious packet recognition, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
